text_note: WikiText-2 raw VALIDATION split, the sibling file of the cell wikitext2_test_raw (no download). OSC.03 profiles were measured on the TEST split + HumanEval, so every doc here is held out from the profiles. An article = the text between two top-level ' = Title = ' headings; each doc = the first L tokens of its article body. Selection rule: the first 9 articles in file order with >= 2048 tokens; the first 8 are eval, the 9th is calibration (reference arm only).
